_doc: SO-101 follower play model (play.py). Per joint [pan, lift, elbow, wrist_flex, wrist_roll, gripper], LeRobot deg (gripper units). servo target = goal + c0 + (c - c_drive) tau + link_sag tau, held inside the band +-(d0 + m |tau|) (+ s when starting from rest). tau = static gravity torque in N m (gravity.py: URDF masses + 20 g wrist camera, sign along the joint axis). c, m pooled over lift / elbow / wrist_flex (one servo P gain + one gear-friction law); c0, d0 per joint; s matched to the real lost motion at reversals (fit.py). Source: 450 kept cal2 teleop episodes (holds) + deployed-controller traces (check). Units: c, m, link_sag deg per N m; c0, d0, s deg.
_link_sag_doc: compliance the encoders do not see (printed horns / links): NOT identified from the encoders; 0 by default. Camera-side hint only (joint fit: grasp views prefer lift ~+2 deg at tau ~0.65 N m -> <= ~3.5 deg/N m). Use dr.link_sag_deg_per_Nm to randomise it.

encoder._doc: STS3215 4096 counts/rev (gripper: LeRobot 0-100 range over its calibrated span, measured step 0.0665 units); at rest the real readings change on 0.2-0.7 % of ticks, by 1 count

_delay_doc: PlayCfg.controller_delay: the deployed controllers' traces fit one extra tick on these joints (one-step K fit: pan 0.32 -> 0.25, wrist_flex 0.35 -> 0.29, wrist_roll 0.40 -> 0.31 deg rmse for delay 0 -> 1); teleop fits delay 0 on all joints

isaac_drive_physical._doc: PlayCfg.drive='physical': arm PD at the real servo stiffness (180/pi / c), damping scaled with it (same 33 ms drive time constant as the twin's 60 / 2); then gravity AND contact loads deflect the arm in PhysX and play adds no sag of its own

dr._doc: per-env uniform draws (Play.sample): multiplicative on c / m / d0 / s, additive on c0 and link_sag (lift, elbow, wrist_flex). c range covers the teleop (2.48-3.17) and trace (3.15-4.14) CIs. Set link_sag_deg_per_Nm e.g. [0, 3.5] to randomise the unidentified camera-only sag.
